name: reassign-worker-after-subagent-completion
title: Allow completed worker subagents to be reassigned under worker role
description: After a subagent completes one assignment, the operator may want to assign that same worker another task. The existing full-history fork path is awkward because it may preserve memory/history but cannot specify the worker role. Add a role-aware reassignment path that can restart a worker with explicit instructions without requiring full-history inheritance.
